items.title: A Taxonomy-Informed Sparse DNA Foundation Model for Microbial Genomics
items.abstract_or_text: Microorganisms are indispensable to terrestrial ecosystems, with their genomic material underpinning critical functions and applications across agriculture, biotechnology, and human health. Although genomic language models have advanced representation learning in DNA sequences, the extensive diversity of microorganisms and imbalanced taxonomic representation in the pretraining corpora pose challenges for effective microbial genomic sequence modeling. Here we present MicroGlot, a taxonomy-informed microbial DNA foundation model pretrained on 3.70 million sequences comprising 378.3 billion nucleotides across 99{,}700 species. MicroGlot encodes the hierarchical relations among taxa through hyperbolic embeddings, incorporating microbial taxonomic knowledge into a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture. Zero-shot evaluation of MicroGlot's layer embeddings demonstrates that the model's representations encode phenotypic traits and taxonomic identity. Comparison with a taxonomy-ablated variant trained under the same pretraining scheme shows that incorporating taxonomic knowledge consistently improves representation quality across the layers of MicroGlot. MicroGlot also combines optimized training techniques with efficient architectural components from modern large language models, achieving leading zero-shot performance across layers and competitive fine-tuning performance with low computational overhead. In a 1000-species set sampled from major cellular domains and viral realms, MicroGlot's routing fingerprints show greater agreement with taxonomic groups than tetranucleotide composition, reflecting taxonomically structured expert routing in multilingual modeling of microbial genomes. Overall, we show that MicroGlot serves as an efficient and effective DNA foundation model for microbial genomic analysis.
items.summary_zh: MicroGlot 在3.70百万条序列、378.3 billion个核苷酸和99,700个物种上预训练，并将分类学知识融入稀疏混合专家架构。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 规模和分类学建模使其适合微生物基因组表示学习；消融与零样本评估支持分类学信息的增益，但尚未等同于具体生物功能的因果预测。
items.abstract_zh: 微生物对陆地生态系统不可或缺，其基因组物质支撑农业、生物技术和人类健康中的关键功能与应用。尽管基因组语言模型已推进 DNA 序列的表示学习，但微生物的高度多样性以及预训练语料中分类学代表性不均衡，给有效的微生物基因组序列建模带来了挑战。我们提出 MicroGlot，一种融入分类学信息的微生物 DNA 基础模型，在由370万条序列组成的语料上预训练，这些序列包含378.3 billion个核苷酸，覆盖99,700个物种。MicroGlot 通过双曲嵌入编码分类单元之间的层级关系，并将微生物分类学知识融入稀疏混合专家架构。对 MicroGlot 各层嵌入进行零样本评估显示，其表示编码了表型性状和分类学身份。与在相同预训练方案下训练的去除分类学信息变体比较表明，纳入分类学知识可在 MicroGlot 的各层持续改善表示质量。MicroGlot 还结合了优化的训练技术和现代大语言模型中的高效架构组件，在各层实现领先的零样本性能，并以较低计算开销取得具有竞争力的微调性能。在一个从主要细胞域和病毒界抽取的1000物种集合中，MicroGlot 的路由指纹与分类群的一致性高于四核苷酸组成，反映出多语言微生物基因组建模中具有分类学结构的专家路由。总体而言，我们表明 MicroGlot 可作为高效且有效的 DNA 基础模型，用于微生物基因组分析。
items.author_line: Li, A. Z., Wang, S., Cheng, S., Du, Y., Liu, R.

items.title: Cell-Lens: Advancing LLM Reasoning at Single-Cell Resolution
items.abstract_or_text: Recent work applies large language models (LLMs) to single-cell data, but the cell usually reaches the model as a short ranked list of genes. This list drops much of what defines a cell, so the model reasons from a partial view. Yet the information is not lost in the measurement, only in the text. Here, we introduce Cell-Lens, a training-free structured representation of the measured cell. It writes the cell as typed blocks, from paired measurements to marker-supported programs. On CellVerse, SOAR, CellPuzzles, and SC-Arena, across five model families, Cell-Lens improves performance by up to 27.1 points. It also narrows the model gap and reduces API-reported reasoning-token usage. The largest gains occur when a defining RNA marker falls out of the ranked list. In these cases, the paired protein data still capture the corresponding signal. Shuffling the added blocks removes the gain. The gain persists after selected label-associated proteins are removed. These controls link the improvement to cell-matched biological content. We also build and release CellSpectrum, a broader benchmark spanning eight sources and seven tasks with paired modalities. The gains hold there across tasks, tissues, and modalities. These results show that a better cell representation can improve single-cell reasoning without retraining the model. Code and CellSpectrum are publicly available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Cell-Lens.
items.summary_zh: Cell-Lens 用带类型的结构化区块表示单细胞测量，在多个单细胞基准和模型家族中提升 LLM 推理性能，最高提升27.1分。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 通过配对蛋白信息补足基因列表丢失的细胞内容，且无需重新训练模型；公开代码和 CellSpectrum 基准增强可复现性。
items.abstract_zh: 近期研究将大语言模型（LLM）应用于单细胞数据，但细胞通常以一份简短的排序基因列表输入模型。这份列表丢失了许多定义细胞的内容，因此模型只能基于不完整视图进行推理。然而，这些信息并未在测量中丢失，只是在转写为文本时丢失了。在此，我们提出 Cell-Lens，一种无需训练的测量细胞结构化表示。它将细胞写成带类型的区块，从配对测量到由标志物支持的程序。在 CellVerse、SOAR、CellPuzzles 和 SC-Arena 上，跨五类模型，Cell-Lens 使性能最高提升27.1分。它还缩小了模型之间的差距，并减少 API 报告的推理 token 使用量。当定义性 RNA 标志物从排序列表中掉出时，增益最大。在这些情况下，配对蛋白数据仍能捕获相应信号。打乱新增区块会消除增益。在移除选定的标签相关蛋白后，增益仍然存在。这些对照将性能改善与匹配该细胞的生物学内容联系起来。我们还构建并发布了 CellSpectrum，这是一个更广泛的基准，覆盖八个来源和七项带配对模态的任务。在不同任务、组织和模态中，增益均在该基准上保持。结果表明，更好的细胞表示可以在不重新训练模型的情况下改善单细胞推理。代码和 CellSpectrum 已公开发布于 https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Cell-Lens。
items.author_line: li, y., Gao, B., Liu, W., Xie, J., Tsui, T. Y., Zhang, Y., Wang, Y., Fu, T., Li, Y.

items.title: Deep generative embeddings of gene expression and splicing reposition the interpretation of single-cell transcriptomic signatures
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell transcriptomic analysis predominantly derives cell identity from gene expression analysis, while alternative splicing is processed separately despite its fundamental role for cell homeostasis. To overcome the limits of separate investigations, we developed a probabilistic deep learning framework, Crecerelle, enabling resolution of the contributions of gene expression and alternative splicing in each cell. Crecerelle learns cell embeddings from gene expressions and alternative splicing isoforms, to decipher their mutually dependent impact on the functional characterisation of cells in a data-driven manner, exemplified for the Tabula Muris dataset. This is enabled through a zero-and-N-inflated Dirichlet-Multinomial for a variational autoencoder that learns cell embeddings solely from splicing profiles, as well as a bi-modal variational autoencoder with a relevance-weighted mixture-of-experts variational posterior to consolidate the modality-specific contribution at single-cell level. Crecerelle reveals cell-type-specific isoform markers as well as subpopulations with unique isoforms and uncovers regulatory and disease-associated pathways not detected by gene expression analyses alone. This scalable and interpretable framework thus allows a more holistic study of transcriptomic regulation and will open a route to modality-relevance-weighted investigations across single-cell multiomics datasets and their influence on cellular homeostasis, tissue development and disease phenotypes.
items.summary_zh: Crecerelle 用生成模型联合基因表达与可变剪接，在 Tabula Muris 中发现细胞类型特异性异构体标志物及仅由剪接揭示的调控和疾病通路。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把通常分开的表达和剪接信号整合到单细胞嵌入中，提供可解释的多组学分析框架；目前示例主要基于 Tabula Muris。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞转录组分析主要通过基因表达分析推断细胞身份，而可变剪接虽然对细胞稳态具有根本作用，却通常被单独处理。为克服分开研究的局限，我们开发了概率深度学习框架 Crecerelle，使每个细胞中基因表达和可变剪接的贡献得到解析。Crecerelle 从基因表达和可变剪接异构体中学习细胞嵌入，以数据驱动的方式解读二者相互依赖的影响；我们以 Tabula Muris 数据集为例展示了这一点。该方法使用零膨胀和 N 膨胀的 Dirichlet-Multinomial 变分自编码器，仅从剪接谱学习细胞嵌入；同时使用带有相关性加权混合专家变分后验的双模态变分自编码器，在单细胞层面整合模态特异性贡献。Crecerelle 揭示了细胞类型特异性异构体标志物以及具有独特异构体的亚群，并发现仅凭基因表达分析无法检测到的调控和疾病相关通路。因此，这一可扩展且可解释的框架可更整体地研究转录组调控，并为在单细胞多组学数据集中开展按模态相关性加权的研究及其对细胞稳态、组织发育和疾病表型的影响开辟路径。
items.author_line: Weberling, F.-M., Ampartzidis, I., Mohorianu, I., Hollfelder, F.

items.title: OmicsResonance: An LLM-assisted cloud ecosystem for interactiveand reproducible single-cell transcriptomic analysis
items.abstract_or_text: While single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) is indispensable, existing analytical tools impose high computational barriers, requiring complex environment configurations and programming proficiency. To democratize single-cell analysis, we developed OmicsResonance, a code-free, web-based platform that eliminates local installations and empowers researchers to execute end-to-end analyses directly within a browser. The platform integrates standard processing pipelines and Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted cell annotation with a suite of advanced modules, including pseudo-time inference, CNV profiling, and virtual knockout simulations. Built on a scalable architecture, OmicsResonance champions "justified analysis" by avoiding black-box defaults. Its interactive interface allows users to dynamically adjust parameters and instantly visualize biological impacts, ensuring transparent and biologically sound analytical decisions. Validation across three public datasets successfully reproduced established findings and facilitated further interpretation of the data. Ultimately, OmicsResonance bridges the gap between complex computational pipelines and bench research, providing an accessible yet powerful environment for scRNA-seq data exploration. The platform is available at https://cloud.rnastar.com/.
items.summary_zh: OmicsResonance 是无需本地安装的浏览器单细胞 RNA-seq 平台，集成标准流程、LLM 辅助注释、拟时序、CNV 和虚拟敲除分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 降低单细胞分析的计算门槛，并强调参数可调和可解释分析；三个公开数据集的复现支持其实用性，但平台仍需更广泛独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）不可或缺，现有分析工具却设置了较高的计算门槛，需要复杂的环境配置和编程能力。为使单细胞分析更加普及，我们开发了 OmicsResonance，这是一个无需代码、基于网页的平台，无需本地安装即可让研究人员直接在浏览器中执行端到端分析。该平台整合了标准处理流程和大语言模型（LLM）辅助的细胞注释，并配备一系列高级模块，包括拟时序推断、CNV 分析和虚拟敲除模拟。OmicsResonance 构建于可扩展架构之上，倡导“有依据的分析”，避免黑箱式默认设置。其交互界面允许用户动态调整参数并即时可视化生物学影响，从而确保分析决策透明且符合生物学逻辑。在三个公开数据集上的验证成功复现了既有发现，并促进了对数据的进一步解释。总体而言，OmicsResonance 弥合了复杂计算流程与台式实验研究之间的差距，为 scRNA-seq 数据探索提供了易用而强大的环境。该平台可用地址为 https://cloud.rnastar.com/。
items.author_line: Chenhui, L., Zhizhen, Q., Yi, L., Qinfen, W., Yan-kai, C., Yi, L., Mingjie, C., Lin, Z.

items.title: HR-FRGS: A Novel Biomarker Discovery Protocol using Dual Layer Hypergraph Learning for NGS RNA Sequence Data
items.abstract_or_text: Biomarker discovery from high-dimensional RNA sequencing data remains challenging. Conventional methods such as differential expression analysis, pairwise protein-protein interaction networks, and weighted gene co-expression network analysis suffer from false-positive interactions, transitivity-driven noise, and arbitrary thresholds for feature selection. Addressing these limitations, this study proposed a novel framework, Hypergraph Regularised Fuzzy Rough Gene Selection (HR-FRGS), for knowledge-driven biomarker discovery. This pipeline integrates information-rich protein clustering with entropy filtering and PPI-pruned co-expression interactions to form a dual-layer hypergraph. A hypergraph-based scoring method that combines Random Walk with Restart diffusion and Hypergraph Betweenness Centrality is used to identify genes that are central in the biological network. Furthermore an autonomous fuzzy rough set selection eliminates arbitrary threshold dependency for gene selection. HR-FRGS was applied to four TCGA cancer cohorts: Lung Adenocarcinoma, Head and Neck Cancer, Kidney Clear Cell Carcinoma, and Colon Cancer, which reduced over 60,000 transcripts to compact biomarker panels. Validation using classical Machine Learning algorithms with cross-validation demonstrated that biomarker panels matched or exceeded the classification performance of the full transcriptome (AUC > 0.99, MCC > 0.94) and confirmed generalizability (MCC \geq 0.893). Benchmarking against baseline methods and an ablation study showed the contribution of major parts of the algorithm. Functional enrichment analysis captures established pan-cancer hallmarks and cohort-specific oncogenic mechanisms, confirming the biological relevance of the identified genes.
items.summary_zh: HR-FRGS 用双层超图、随机游走扩散、超图介数中心性和模糊粗糙集，从四个 TCGA 癌症队列中筛选紧凑生物标志物面板。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对高维 RNA-seq 的假阳性、传递性噪声和阈值依赖提出组合式方案；交叉验证和消融分析支持方法贡献，但分类性能可能受队列与验证设计影响。
items.abstract_zh: 从高维 RNA 测序数据中发现生物标志物仍然具有挑战性。差异表达分析、成对蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络和加权基因共表达网络分析等传统方法容易受到假阳性交互、由传递性驱动的噪声以及特征选择中任意阈值的影响。为应对这些局限，本研究提出了用于知识驱动生物标志物发现的新框架——超图正则化模糊粗糙基因选择（HR-FRGS）。该流程将包含丰富信息的蛋白质聚类与熵过滤、以及经 PPI 剪枝的共表达交互结合，形成双层超图。基于超图的评分方法结合带重启的随机游走扩散和超图介数中心性，以识别生物网络中的中心基因。此外，自主模糊粗糙集选择消除了基因选择对任意阈值的依赖。HR-FRGS 应用于四个 TCGA 癌症队列：肺腺癌、头颈癌、肾透明细胞癌和结肠癌，将超过60,000条转录本压缩为紧凑的生物标志物面板。使用经典机器学习算法进行交叉验证表明，这些生物标志物面板的分类性能达到或超过全转录组（AUC > 0.99，MCC > 0.94），并显示出可推广性（MCC ≥ 0.893）。与基线方法的比较和消融研究显示了算法主要组成部分的贡献。功能富集分析捕获了已知的泛癌标志和队列特异性致癌机制，支持所识别基因的生物学相关性。
items.author_line: Gupta, M. K., Paul, M., Pati, S. K.

items.title: Differentiating benign from malignant adnexal masses by biomarker-agnostic plasma proteomics using adaptive machine learning
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Pre-operative triage of adnexal masses with serum CA-125, HE4, and ultrasound (O-RADS) has limited accuracy, contributing to unnecessary surgery. We develop and validate a first of its kind, biomarker panel-free plasma proteomic classifier that distinguishes malignant from benign adnexal masses from a single blood draw, operating directly on discovery-mode mass spectrometry. Methods: In this multicenter prospective observational study, plasma from women with adnexal masses and from healthy controls at a large urban academic center (discovery and four validation cohorts) and an external academic center from another Urban-suburban area (external validation) was analyzed by data-independent-acquisition mass spectrometry (Orbitrap Astral), quantifying >1,000 proteins per sample. Cancerous (malignant, borderline adnexal mass, or metastasis to ovary) versus benign adnexal masses were classified with ADAPT-MS (Adaptive Diagnostic Architecture for Personalized Testing by Mass Spectrometry), which retrains an ElasticNet model for each sample based on the proteins measured. The primary outcome was discrimination (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUC]). Pre-operative O-RADS scores and serum CA-125 were compared and combined with proteomics on matched subsets. Findings: Using a discovery cohort (n=1062), an ADAPT-MS classifier, validated across five independent cohorts (n=623), achieved a summary AUC of 0.835 (cohort range 0.779-0.904). Among patients with pre-operative O-RADS (n=231), proteomics (AUC 0.852) was comparable to O-RADS alone (0.863) and combining them raised discrimination to 0.922. Proteomics outperformed serum CA-125 (0.915 versus 0.777; n=125) and proteome-derived ROMA-like and two-marker surrogates. Biologically, the classification-relevant proteins are enriched for host response proteins rather than tumor cell associated protein changes, comprising ECM remodeling, complement and innate immune response pathways. This explains good detection of tumor with heterogenous pathology and also metastasis to ovary. Interpretation: A single plasma proteomic measurement interpreted using adaptive machine learning discriminates malignant from benign adnexal masses with good internal and external validation, and is complementary to ultrasound, warranting prospective evaluation as a panel-free diagnostic adjunct to imaging.
items.summary_zh: ADAPT-MS 直接从发现模式质谱血浆蛋白组区分良恶性附件包块，在发现队列和五个独立验证队列中评估，并可与 O-RADS 联合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 具有前瞻性、多中心和外部验证，提示无固定生物标志物面板的自适应蛋白组模型可作为影像辅助；仍需前瞻性临床效用验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：使用血清 CA-125、HE4 和超声（O-RADS）对附件包块进行术前分诊的准确性有限，导致不必要的手术。我们开发并验证了一种首创的、无生物标志物面板限制的血浆蛋白组分类器，仅凭一次采血即可区分恶性和良性附件包块，并直接作用于发现模式质谱。方法：在这项多中心前瞻性观察性研究中，我们分析了来自大型城市学术中心的附件包块女性患者和健康对照者的血浆（包括发现队列和四个验证队列），并在另一个城市-郊区地区的学术中心进行外部验证；使用数据非依赖采集质谱（Orbitrap Astral）对每个样本定量超过1,000种蛋白质。使用 ADAPT-MS（Adaptive Diagnostic Architecture for Personalized Testing by Mass Spectrometry）对癌性附件包块（恶性、交界性附件包块或卵巢转移）与良性附件包块进行分类；该方法根据每个样本实际测得的蛋白质重新训练 ElasticNet 模型。主要结局为区分能力，即受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）。在匹配子集中比较并联合了术前 O-RADS 评分、血清 CA-125 和蛋白组。结果：在发现队列（n=1062）中，ADAPT-MS 分类器在五个独立队列中得到验证（n=623），汇总 AUC 为0.835（各队列范围0.779–0.904）。在具有术前 O-RADS 评分的患者中（n=231），蛋白组（AUC 0.852）与单独 O-RADS（0.863）相当，二者联合后区分能力升至0.922。蛋白组优于血清 CA-125（0.915 对0.777；n=125），也优于蛋白组衍生的 ROMA 类和双标志物替代指标。在生物学方面，与分类相关的蛋白质富集于宿主反应蛋白，而非肿瘤细胞相关的蛋白质变化，包括细胞外基质重塑、补体和先天免疫反应通路。这解释了其对具有异质性病理的肿瘤以及卵巢转移的良好检测能力。解释：使用自适应机器学习解释的一次血浆蛋白组测量，结合良好的内部和外部验证，可以区分恶性与良性附件包块，并且与超声互补；该方法值得作为影像学辅助诊断工具接受前瞻性评估。
items.author_line: Mueller-Reif, J. B., Ackroyd, S., Albrecht, V., Weigert, M., Korff, K., Schebesta, A.-S., Yoeli-Bik, R., Siddiqui, M., Rausch, A., Zsiros, E., Mann, M., Lengyel, E.

items.title: CMAC: A deep learning framework for absolute cardiomyocyte transcriptional age estimation
items.abstract_or_text: Cardiomyocyte maturation spans embryogenesis through postnatal life and involves coordinated transcriptional transitions that are disrupted in disease and incompletely recapitulated by stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes. However, no unified framework exists for assigning absolute transcriptional maturation age across datasets, platforms, and experimental conditions. Here, we developed CMAC (Cardiomyocyte Maturation Age Clock), integrating 18 murine single-cell RNA-sequencing datasets spanning embryonic and postnatal timepoints, into a batch-invariant probabilistic atlas using single cell variational inference (scVI) with a 100-dimensional latent representation. Analysis of the developmental trajectory revealed highly non-uniform transcriptional change, with 63.9% of the total transcriptional journey completed by birth and the neonatal transition representing the largest single transcriptional step. An XGBoost regressor trained on the CMAC latent space predicted absolute chronological age with a leave-one-dataset-out mean absolute error (MAE) of 4.09 days (median 3.27 days), Pearson r = 0.903, and Spearman {rho} = 0.908 across 18 datasets and six sequencing platforms, outperforming linear regression (MAE = 6.18 days) and PCA-based representations (MAE = 6.35 days). In an independent P14 cohort comprising 98,163 cardiomyocytes from six biological replicates, CMAC achieved a mouse-level MAE of 0.33 days, with all six mice predicted within 1.1 days of chronological age. Application of CMAC to a previously published PGC1/{beta} double-knockout model with established delayed cardiomyocyte maturation independently recapitulated this phenotype, quantifying maturation deficits of 4.77 to 8.60 days across P7 to P28, with the largest deficit at P14. Together, these results establish CMAC as a quantitative, deep learning framework for assigning absolute transcriptional maturation age and quantifying deviations from normal cardiomyocyte development.
items.summary_zh: CMAC 整合18个小鼠单细胞 RNA-seq 数据集，建立跨平台心肌细胞转录成熟年龄图谱，并在独立队列和敲除模型中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供可量化的绝对成熟年龄和发育偏差指标，跨六个平台表现稳定，并能重现已知 PGC1/β 双敲除成熟延迟表型。
items.abstract_zh: 心肌细胞成熟从胚胎发生延续至出生后阶段，涉及协调的转录变化；这些变化在疾病中会受到破坏，并且无法被干细胞来源的心肌细胞充分重现。然而，目前还不存在一个统一框架，能够跨数据集、平台和实验条件分配绝对转录成熟年龄。在此，我们开发了 CMAC（Cardiomyocyte Maturation Age Clock），将覆盖胚胎和出生后时间点的18个小鼠单细胞 RNA 测序数据集整合为批次不变的概率图谱，使用单细胞变分推断（scVI）构建100维潜在表示。发育轨迹分析显示，转录变化并不均匀，其中63.9%的总转录历程在出生前完成，新生儿期转变代表最大的单一转录步骤。在 CMAC 潜在空间上训练的 XGBoost 回归器，在18个数据集和六种测序平台上进行留一数据集外验证时，预测绝对年龄的平均绝对误差（MAE）为4.09天（中位数3.27天），Pearson r = 0.903，Spearman {rho} = 0.908，优于线性回归（MAE = 6.18天）和基于 PCA 的表示（MAE = 6.35天）。在包含六个生物学重复、共98,163个心肌细胞的独立 P14 队列中，CMAC 达到小鼠层面的 MAE 0.33天，六只小鼠的预测值均在实际年龄的1.1天以内。将 CMAC 应用于已发表的 PGC1/{beta} 双敲除模型时，该模型已知存在心肌细胞成熟延迟；CMAC 独立重现了这一表型，并在 P7 至 P28 期间量化出4.77至8.60天的成熟缺陷，其中 P14 时缺陷最大。总之，这些结果建立了一个定量深度学习框架，用于分配绝对转录成熟年龄并量化心肌细胞正常发育的偏离。
items.author_line: Quansah, K., Zureick, N., Chen, E., Murphy, S., Anderson, E., Kwon, E., Suh, D., Stein O'Brien, G., Cahan, P., Kwon, C.

items.title: WHAT IS NORMAL? MULTIMODAL CHARACTERIZATION OF NON-DISEASED PEDIATRIC DUODENAL BIOPSIES USING MACHINE LEARNING IMAGE ANALYSIS AND TRANSCRIPTOMICS
items.abstract_or_text: Pediatric endoscopy is performed only when clinically indicated, limiting access to healthy duodenal tissue. Biopsies with duodenal no pathologic abnormality (NPA) are often used as controls despite the presence of symptoms or inflammatory disease found elsewhere in the gastrointestinal (GI) tract. We characterized pediatric duodenal NPA tissue across clinical, histologic, cellular, and transcriptomic domains. Methods Archival duodenal NPA biopsies were obtained with clinical metadata and hematoxylin-and-eosin whole-slide images (WSIs). Duodenal mRNA-seq data were analyzed from a subset of patients with duodenal NPA. Clinical metadata and WSIs underwent machine-learning analysis, cell populations were quantified from WSIs, and RNA-seq data underwent differential expression and pathway-enrichment analyses. Results The primary cohort included 195 patients with duodenal NPA. Comparisons between patients with non-duodenal GI disease and those with no GI disease showed differences in inflammatory biomarkers and follow-up utilization. Unsupervised clinical clustering identified three clusters with partial enrichment for IBD with colonic inflammation and Eosinophilic Esophagitis (EoE) with esophageal inflammation. Supervised clinical classification showed modest discrimination. WSI clustering showed limited disease-status discrimination, and cell quantification showed no significant group differences. In the separate RNA-seq cohort of 43 patients, differential-expression and pathway-enrichment analyses identified transcriptional and pathway-level differences between disease-status groups. Conclusions This multi-level characterization indicates that pediatric duodenal NPA tissue should not be treated as a uniform control category. Clinical metadata and transcriptomics revealed clinical and molecular heterogeneity, while histologic and cell analyses showed limited disease-status separation, supporting a refined definition of control tissue.
items.summary_zh: 对195例儿科十二指肠无病理异常活检进行临床、组织学、细胞和转录组多层表征，显示所谓正常对照组织存在临床和分子异质性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提示儿科研究中“无病理异常”组织不应被视为均一对照；多模态结果能帮助改进对照定义，但部分组织学指标区分度有限。
items.abstract_zh: 儿科内镜只有在具有临床指征时才会进行，因此健康十二指肠组织难以获得。十二指肠无病理异常（NPA）的活检通常被用作对照，尽管患者可能存在症状，或胃肠道（GI）其他部位存在炎症性疾病。我们从临床、组织学、细胞和转录组层面对儿科十二指肠 NPA 组织进行了表征。方法：获取带有临床元数据和苏木精-伊红全切片图像（WSI）的存档十二指肠 NPA 活检。对一部分十二指肠 NPA 患者分析 mRNA-seq 数据。使用机器学习分析临床元数据和 WSI，对 WSI 中的细胞群进行定量，并对 RNA-seq 数据开展差异表达和通路富集分析。结果：主要队列包括195例十二指肠 NPA 患者。比较存在非十二指肠 GI 疾病的患者与无 GI 疾病患者，发现炎症生物标志物和随访利用情况存在差异。无监督临床聚类识别出三个簇，其中部分簇分别富集于伴结肠炎症的炎症性肠病（IBD）和伴食管炎症的嗜酸性食管炎（EoE）。监督式临床分类显示区分能力有限。WSI 聚类对疾病状态的区分也有限，细胞定量未发现组间显著差异。在包含43例患者的独立 RNA-seq 队列中，差异表达和通路富集分析发现了不同疾病状态组之间的转录和通路层面差异。结论：这种多层表征表明，儿科十二指肠 NPA 组织不应被视为统一的对照类别。临床元数据和转录组揭示了临床与分子异质性，而组织学和细胞分析显示疾病状态分离有限，支持对对照组织进行更精细的定义。
items.author_line: Chotani, A., Liu, J., Moradinasab, N., Khan, S., Sessions, J., Rhoads, F., Srivastava, S., Zulqarnain, F., Jain, V., Raghavan, S., Moskaluk, C., Greene, A., Marie, C., Brown, D., Syed, S.

items.title: Decoding subtype development and function in human pluripotent stem cell-derived midbrain dopaminergic neurons
items.abstract_or_text: Midbrain dopaminergic (mDA) neurons comprise molecularly and functionally distinct subtypes with differential vulnerability in neurodegenerative and psychiatric disorders. However, the mechanisms specifying subtype identity remain poorly understood, and protocols for the selective derivation of human mDA subtypes are lacking. Here we establish a strategy to derive substantia nigra (A9) and ventral tegmental area (A10) mDA neurons from human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs). A9 identity is specified by dual-SMAD activation through Activin A and BMP7 at the midbrain floor-plate progenitor stage, whereas A10 identity is promoted by BMP inhibition. A9 mDA neurons are purified based on ALDH1A1 expression, and subtype identity is maintained by continued TGF-{beta} modulation and ESRRB activation in vitro and upon transplantation in vivo. Single-cell RNA sequencing and biochemical analyses demonstrate that hPSC-derived A9 neurons exhibit increased oxidative phosphorylation, neuromelanin-like pigmentation, elevated dopamine synthesis and release, and electrophysiological properties characteristic of A9 mDA neurons in vivo. Integration with human fetal midbrain datasets confirms strong transcriptional concordance between in vitro-derived and in vivo mDA subtypes. Neuromelanin-like structures produced by hPSC-derived A9 neurons trigger pro-inflammatory cytokine secretion from hPSC-derived microglia, and A9 neurons are primed to upregulate MHC-I genes in response to interferon-{gamma}, features which may contribute to the selective vulnerability of A9 neurons. Together, these results establish a robust in vitro platform to interrogate human mDA subtype development, function, and selective vulnerability, enabling mechanistic studies relevant to Parkinson's disease and the development of cell-based therapies.
items.summary_zh: 研究建立由人多能干细胞生成黑质 A9 和腹侧被盖区 A10 多巴胺能神经元的策略，并用单细胞、移植和微胶质实验解析亚型特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时提供亚型分化机制、体外功能、体内维持和疾病相关易感性证据，为 Parkinson's disease 研究与细胞疗法开发提供平台。
items.abstract_zh: 中脑多巴胺能（mDA）神经元包含分子和功能上不同的亚型，这些亚型对神经退行性疾病和精神疾病的易感性不同。然而，决定亚型身份的机制仍未充分理解，选择性生成不同人类 mDA 亚型的方案也很缺乏。在此，我们建立了一种从人多能干细胞（hPSC）生成黑质（A9）和腹侧被盖区（A10）mDA 神经元的策略。在中脑底板祖细胞阶段，通过 Activin A 和 BMP7 进行双 SMAD 激活来确定 A9 身份，而抑制 BMP 则促进 A10 身份。根据 ALDH1A1 表达纯化 A9 mDA 神经元，并通过持续的 TGF-{beta} 调节和 ESRRB 激活，使亚型身份在体外和移植到体内后得以维持。单细胞 RNA 测序和生化分析显示，hPSC 来源的 A9 神经元具有增强的氧化磷酸化、类似神经黑色素的色素沉着、升高的多巴胺合成与释放，以及体内 A9 mDA 神经元特征性的电生理性质。与人胎儿中脑数据集整合后，证实体外生成的 mDA 亚型与体内亚型具有很强的转录一致性。hPSC 来源 A9 神经元产生的类神经黑色素结构会诱导 hPSC 来源微胶质细胞分泌促炎细胞因子；A9 神经元还准备在干扰素-{gamma}刺激下上调 MHC-I 基因，这些特征可能促成 A9 神经元的选择性易感性。总之，这些结果建立了一个稳健的体外平台，用于研究人 mDA 亚型的发育、功能和选择性易感性，并支持与 Parkinson's disease 相关的机制研究及细胞疗法开发。
items.author_line: Yang, D., Choi, S., Piao, J., Evangelisti, A., Yang, Z., Bocchi, V. D., Donohue, S. A., Claros, N., Jungverdorben, J., Sidharta, M., Wu, Y., Pasolli, H. A., Kim, T. W., Zhou, T., Sulzer, D., Mosharov, E., Tabar, V., Studer, L.

items.title: RNA Splicing of the REST Gene by SRRM4 in Vascular Smooth Muscle Cells Promotes Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Development
items.abstract_or_text: BackgroundThe progression of abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) is closely associated with the phenotypic switch of vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMC). While members of the Serine/Arginine-rich splicing factor (SRs) superfamily are increasingly acknowledged for their pivotal role in modulating cell phenotype, the specific contribution of these factors to AAA development has remained underexplored. MethodsThrough integrated analyses the whole transcriptome of human and murine AAA tissues derived from clinical samples and animal models, we identified serine-arginine repeat matrix 4 (SRRM4) as a candidate gene regulating AAA formation. To investigate the role of SRRM4 in AAA formation, we used global and VSMC-specific SRRM4-knockout mice to construct AAA mouse models in two different ways. The impact of SRRM4 on AAA was further investigated in in vivo and in vitro models ResultsElevated levels of SRRM4 mRNA and protein were observed in VSMC from both human and murine AAA tissues. Targeted silencing of SRRM4 in VSMC (but not in endothelial or myeloid cells) significantly attenuated AAA formation in both AngII- and CaCl2-induced mouse models. Our results identify the RE1 silencing transcription factor (REST) as a critical target gene of SRRM4 in AAA, a master regulator of cellular phenotypic stability. We show that SRRM4 modulates VSMC phenotype through alternative splicing of the REST gene, resulting in a non-functional REST4 isoform. Furthermore, our study shows that REST directly represses STAT1, a mechanism by which SRRM4 influences VSMC phenotypic transition. Regarding clinical significance, inhibition of both STAT1 expression and function was shown to be beneficial in preventing AAA formation and slowing disease progression in mouse models. ConclusionsThis investigation uncovers a previously unrecognized role of SRRM4-mediated splicing of the REST gene in the progression of AAA and identifies a novel REST/STAT1 axis critical in the phenotypic modulation of VSMC. The findings of this study may provide insights for the development of innovative therapeutic strategies for AAA. What is New?O_LIOur study demonstrates that the RNA splicing factor SRRM4 (serine/arginine repetitive matrix 4) expression is increased in human and murine abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) tissues and unveils a previously undescribed role of SRRM4 in regulating AAA development. C_LIO_LISRRM4 promotes AAA development and progression through inducing splicing of REST (RE1 silencing transcription factor) gene and upregulating STAT1 (signal transducer and activator of transcription 1) expression, which result in extracellular matrix degradation, inflammation, and VSMC phenotypic switching. C_LIO_LIOur study provides proof-of-concept evidence indicating the therapeutic value of STAT1 inhibition in AAA prevention and treatment. C_LI What Are the Clinical Implications?O_LIOur study defining a novel mechanism underlying the SRRM4/REST/STAT1 axis is crucial for developing new therapeutic strategies for AAA. C_LIO_LIBased on these findings, we have initiated a prospective study (REST4-AAA; ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT07056491) to evaluate REST4 expression levels in serum of AAA patients and explore its potential as a serum biomarker for AAA prediction C_LIO_LIOur findings indicate that fludarabine, a clinically available agent reported to selectively suppress STAT1, effectively attenuates AAA progression in mice, suggesting its potential for repurposing as a therapeutic strategy for AAA. C_LI
items.summary_zh: 整合人和小鼠 AAA 组织、VSMC 特异性 SRRM4 敲除模型及体内外实验，提出 SRRM4/REST/STAT1 剪接轴与腹主动脉瘤进展相关。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时包含临床样本、动物模型和机制实验，并已启动 REST4-AAA 前瞻性研究；当前治疗意义仍主要来自小鼠证据。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：腹主动脉瘤（AAA）的进展与血管平滑肌细胞（VSMC）的表型转换密切相关。尽管富含丝氨酸/精氨酸的剪接因子（SR）超家族成员越来越被认为在调节细胞表型方面具有关键作用，但这些因子对 AAA 发展的具体贡献仍研究不足。方法：通过整合来源于临床样本和动物模型的人与小鼠 AAA 组织全转录组分析，我们鉴定出丝氨酸-精氨酸重复基质4（SRRM4）这一可能调控 AAA 形成的候选基因。为研究 SRRM4 对 AAA 形成的作用，我们使用全身性和 VSMC 特异性 SRRM4 敲除小鼠，以两种不同方式构建 AAA 小鼠模型。随后在体内和体外模型中进一步研究 SRRM4 的影响。结果：在人和小鼠 AAA 组织的 VSMC 中，SRRM4 mRNA 和蛋白水平均升高。在 VSMC 中靶向沉默 SRRM4（而不是在内皮细胞或髓系细胞中沉默）可在 AngII 和 CaCl2 诱导的两种小鼠模型中显著减轻 AAA 形成。我们的结果将 RE1 沉默转录因子（REST）确定为 SRRM4 的关键靶基因，它是细胞表型稳定性的主调控因子。我们显示，SRRM4 通过对 REST 基因进行可变剪接，产生无功能的 REST4 异构体，从而调节 VSMC 表型。此外，我们的研究显示，REST 直接抑制 STAT1；SRRM4 通过这一机制影响 VSMC 表型转换。在临床意义方面，抑制 STAT1 表达和功能已被证明有益于在小鼠模型中预防 AAA 形成并减缓疾病进展。结论：本研究揭示了 SRRM4 介导的 REST 基因剪接在 AAA 进展中的此前未被认识的作用，并确定了对 VSMC 表型调节至关重要的新型 REST/STAT1 轴。这些发现可能为 AAA 创新治疗策略的开发提供线索。新发现：我们的研究显示，RNA 剪接因子 SRRM4 在人和小鼠 AAA 组织中的表达升高，并揭示了 SRRM4 调控 AAA 发展的此前未描述作用。SRRM4 通过诱导 REST（RE1 silencing transcription factor）基因剪接并上调 STAT1（signal transducer and activator of transcription 1）表达，促进 AAA 形成和进展，进而导致细胞外基质降解、炎症和 VSMC 表型转换。本研究提供了 STAT1 抑制在 AAA 预防和治疗中治疗价值的概念验证证据。临床意义：本研究界定的 SRRM4/REST/STAT1 轴机制对于开发 AAA 新治疗策略至关重要。基于这些发现，我们已启动前瞻性研究 REST4-AAA（ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT07056491），评估 AAA 患者血清中的 REST4 表达水平，并探索其作为 AAA 预测血清生物标志物的潜力。我们的研究结果显示，fludarabine（一种已有临床应用、据报道可选择性抑制 STAT1 的药物）能够有效减缓小鼠 AAA 进展，提示其可能被重新定位为治疗策略。
items.author_line: Li, Y., Wang, Y., Ni, Q., Yang, S., Qi, H., Yao, Y., Wang, H., Xu, W., Yuan, K., Lv, L., Guo, X., Ye, M., Xue, G., Tang, W. H., Pu, J., Zhang, L.

items.title: Genomic foundation models extend clinicopathologic and transcriptomic prognostication in soft tissue sarcoma
items.abstract_or_text: BackgroundClinicopathologic (SARCULATOR) and transcriptomic (CINSARC) models are established prognostication tools in soft tissue sarcoma, but neither directly represent the sequence context of tumor genomic alterations. Evo2 is a genomic foundation model trained to learn the grammar of DNA/RNA sequences. We tested whether Evo2-derived features from tumor short variants, fusions, and rearrangements improve survival prognostication beyond clinicopathologic and transcriptomic risk models. MethodsWe analysed formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tumor material and clinical data from 102 patients with dedifferentiated liposarcoma (n = 25), high-grade leiomyosarcoma (n = 25), and undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma (n = 52). A separate TCGA-SARC cohort of comparable histologies (n = 129) served as external validation. Reconstructable alterations (short variants, fusions and rearrangements) were converted into sequence inputs, embedded with Evo2 and aggregated into patient-level genomic representations. Cox proportional hazards models incorporated genomic features alone (Evo2) or together with clinicopathologic (SARCULATOR) or transcriptomic (CINSARC) predictors across overall survival (OS), progression-free survival (PFS), disease-free survival (DFS), relapse-free survival (RFS), and metastasis-free survival (MFS). Discrimination was assessed using Harrells concordance index (C-index). ResultsEvo2 features were generated from 174 study-cohort sequences and 7298 TCGA-SARC sequences. In the study cohort, adding Evo2 to SARCULATOR increased the reported C-index for OS from 0.620 to 0.770, PFS from 0.625 to 0.755, DFS from 0.612 to 0.714, and RFS from 0.633 to 0.771. In TCGA-SARC, SARCULATOR plus Evo2 increased the OS C-index from 0.595 to 0.716 and the MFS C-index from 0.548 to 0.667. Also in TCGA-SARC, adding Evo2 to CINSARC increased the OS C-index from 0.476 to 0.653 and the MFS C-index from 0.553 to 0.650. These are descriptive point-estimate comparisons. Moreover, in TCGA-SARC Evo2 alone outperformed SARCULATOR alone and CINSARC alone, supporting independent prognostic information within altered sequence-context representations. ConclusionsEvo2-derived genomic representations improved clinicopathologic and transcriptomic prognostication across sarcoma cohorts and survival endpoints. These findings support genomic foundation models as an independent and complementary layer for sarcoma risk stratification through direct modeling of altered tumor sequence biology. Confirmation of model transportability, calibration and clinical utility is required before clinical application. items.summary_zh: Evo2 从肿瘤短变异、融合和重排构建序列表示，在软组织肉瘤研究队列及 TCGA-SARC 外部队列中提升生存预后模型的 C-index。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把基因组序列上下文作为临床预后模型的补充层，并有独立外部队列；摘要明确指出这些是描述性点估计，尚未证明临床效用。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：临床病理学模型（SARCULATOR）和转录组模型（CINSARC）是软组织肉瘤中已建立的预后工具，但二者都没有直接表示肿瘤基因组改变的序列上下文。Evo2 是一个经过训练以学习 DNA/RNA 序列语法的基因组基础模型。我们测试了从肿瘤短变异、融合和重排得到的 Evo2 特征，是否能在临床病理学和转录组风险模型之外改善生存预后。方法：我们分析了102例患者的福尔马林固定石蜡包埋肿瘤材料和临床数据，包括去分化脂肪肉瘤（n = 25）、高级别平滑肌肉瘤（n = 25）和未分化多形性肉瘤（n = 52）。另一个具有相近组织学类型的 TCGA-SARC 队列（n = 129）作为外部验证。可重建的改变（短变异、融合和重排）被转换为序列输入，经 Evo2 嵌入后聚合为患者层面的基因组表示。Cox 比例风险模型分别纳入单独的基因组特征（Evo2），或与临床病理学（SARCULATOR）或转录组（CINSARC）预测因子联合，并评估总生存期（OS）、无进展生存期（PFS）、无病生存期（DFS）、无复发生存期（RFS）和无转移生存期（MFS）。使用 Harrell 一致性指数（C-index）评估区分能力。结果：研究队列生成了174条序列的 Evo2 特征，TCGA-SARC 生成了7298条序列的特征。在研究队列中，将 Evo2 加入 SARCULATOR 后，报告的 OS C-index 从0.620升至0.770，PFS 从0.625升至0.755，DFS 从0.612升至0.714，RFS 从0.633升至0.771。在 TCGA-SARC 中，SARCULATOR 加 Evo2 将 OS C-index 从0.595升至0.716，将 MFS C-index 从0.548升至0.667。同样在 TCGA-SARC 中，将 Evo2 加入 CINSARC 后，OS C-index 从0.476升至0.653，MFS C-index 从0.553升至0.650。这些是描述性点估计比较。此外，在 TCGA-SARC 中，Evo2 单独使用优于 SARCULATOR 单独使用和 CINSARC 单独使用，支持改变序列上下文表示中存在独立预后信息。结论：Evo2 衍生的基因组表示在多个肉瘤队列和生存终点上改善了临床病理学和转录组预后。这些结果支持基因组基础模型作为肉瘤风险分层中独立且互补的一层，通过直接建模改变的肿瘤序列生物学发挥作用。在临床应用前，仍需确认模型的可迁移性、校准性和临床效用。图示摘要：肉瘤预后的基因组序列表示。重建的短变异和研究队列融合代理被 Evo2 处理，并聚合为患者层面的基因组谱，用于带岭惩罚的 Cox 生存建模。基因组谱单独评估，或与临床病理学 SARCULATOR 或转录组 CINSARC 预测因子联合评估；CINSARC 仅在 TCGA-SARC 中评估。下方面板显示加入 Evo2 特征前后的报告总体生存 Harrell C-index 点估计。这些描述性比较不确立统计学显著性或临床效用。{Delta} 表示平均序列对数似然的替代值减参考值。嵌入位移表示成对短变异嵌入之间的余弦距离。FFPE，福尔马林固定石蜡包埋；TCGA-SARC，The Cancer Genome Atlas 肉瘤队列。使用 BioRender 创建。
items.author_line: Esperanca-Martins, M., Sokolov Ravasqueira, M., Dias, S., Abecasis, N., Costa, L., Vasques, H.

review.note: 候选集共60项，全部标记为 preprint；没有 peer_reviewed 或 clinical publication_status。以下16项均达到质量分70，按生物学意义、方法创新、数据规模及实验/临床证据排序；临床相关条目仍按 preprint 处理，未将相关性表述为因果结论。已依据目标日期前综合日报归档排除重复报道。
